metric_catalog.definition: Matched prior-D30+ loans returning current divided by matched prior-D30+ loans.
metric_catalog.method: Reported by prior UPB and loan count.
metric_catalog.baseline: Established by the M8 full-data run.
metric_catalog.limitation: A cure may be temporary; repeat delinquency is not inferred.

metric_catalog.definition: Matched prior-current loans becoming D30+ divided by matched prior-current loans.
metric_catalog.method: Reported by prior UPB and loan count.
metric_catalog.baseline: Established by the M8 full-data run.
metric_catalog.supported_decision: Find deals with rising early-stage delinquency pressure.
metric_catalog.limitation: Only adjacent-period matched loans are eligible.

metric_catalog.definition: Matched prior-D30 loans becoming D60+ divided by matched prior-D30 loans.
metric_catalog.method: Reported by prior UPB and loan count.
metric_catalog.baseline: Established by the M8 full-data run.
metric_catalog.limitation: Small denominators require count and balance context.

metric_catalog.definition: Current eligible D60+ rate minus its prior-period rate, multiplied by 10,000.
metric_catalog.method: One- and three-period window comparisons within the same deal or portfolio.
metric_catalog.supported_decision: Rank the largest deteriorations for investigation.
metric_catalog.limitation: Population change can combine performance and mix effects.

metric_catalog.definition: Average deal D60+ rate multiplied by the change in that deal's eligible-UPB weight.
metric_catalog.desired_direction: Context; positive adverse contribution is undesirable.
metric_catalog.baseline: Established by the M8 full-data run.
metric_catalog.supported_decision: Distinguish performance movement from portfolio composition.
metric_catalog.limitation: Mix is descriptive and depends on the selected cohort boundary.

metric_catalog.definition: Eligible Current Actual UPB with delinquency months >=2 divided by eligible current UPB.
metric_catalog.method: UPB-weighted anchor rate; release-compatible denominator is also retained.
metric_catalog.supported_decision: Rank deals and explain changes in severe delinquency.
metric_catalog.limitation: Not a loss estimate, tranche metric, or borrower score.

metric_catalog.definition: Average deal UPB weight multiplied by the change in that deal's eligible D60+ rate.
metric_catalog.method: Exact midpoint decomposition by deal; entry/exit rates are held at the observed rate.
metric_catalog.baseline: Established by the M8 full-data run.
metric_catalog.supported_decision: Identify which deal's performance drove the portfolio change.

metric_catalog.definition: Sum of Current Actual UPB for positive-balance loans with a numeric delinquency state and no zero-balance code.
metric_catalog.method: Decimal sum after typed validity and active-population rules.
metric_catalog.baseline: Existing release reported current UPB is retained separately for reconciliation.
metric_catalog.supported_decision: Size and compare the active collateral population.
metric_catalog.limitation: Excludes REO/unknown states; Current Actual UPB can include deferred non-interest-bearing principal.

metric_catalog.definition: Prior-period records found under the same deal, pool, and loan key in the next adjacent period divided by prior records.
metric_catalog.method: Adjacent-period key reconciliation with approved-exit and error classes.
metric_catalog.baseline: Established by the M8 full-data run.
metric_catalog.supported_decision: Decide whether transition metrics are sufficiently complete to use.
metric_catalog.limitation: A source revision or identifier change can break matching and must be investigated.

metric_catalog.definition: New zero-balance code 01 prior UPB divided by beginning eligible UPB.
metric_catalog.method: Adjacent-period event detection using the official Actual Loss mapping.
metric_catalog.baseline: Established by the M8 full-data run.
metric_catalog.supported_decision: Separate payoff-driven runoff from adverse exits.
metric_catalog.limitation: Uses the observed HQA Actual Loss pool construct only.

metric_catalog.definition: Signed deal contribution to the portfolio monthly D60+ rate change, in basis points.
metric_catalog.method: Current deal weight times current D60+ rate minus prior deal weight times prior D60+ rate; exactly equals rate effect plus mix effect.
metric_catalog.desired_direction: Lower or negative contribution is favorable.
metric_catalog.supported_decision: Choose which deal contribution to investigate first.
metric_catalog.limitation: Contribution depends on both performance and portfolio weight and does not establish causality.
